featured_reviews.name: Om Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very worst experience with the staff and technician team. There was an issue with the game, and when I asked the staff for help, the first response I got was, “Inform the technician, not me.” Amazing customer service standards.

Even after I personally found the technician and explained the issue properly, he barely looked into it. We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.

featured_reviews.name: SAHIL RATNAPARKHI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited FunTime Carnival and overall it was a really great experience. It’s an all-year-round carnival with a good variety of rides, each priced differently — ₹100, ₹200, or ₹300 per person.
The entry ticket is ₹100 per head, and that ticket can be used for any ride of the same cost, which is a nice and flexible system.
We had a great time — bumper cars, kids’ play area, and the zip-line adventure zone were definite highlights. We visited in the second week after opening, so some rides were still being installed and work was ongoing, which is understandable.

One major downside was the Arcade zone inside. It consists of machine games and prize-winning games. Entry is ₹200 per person, and you get three attempts at each of the five games. However, you only get a prize if you win all five games, which is practically impossible since a few games are quite tricky.
The prize is just a small (~30 cm) stuffed toy, which is not worth the price. Bigger toys are displayed but cannot be won. This wasn’t clearly explained beforehand — otherwise, we wouldn’t have played at all. I’d strongly suggest skipping the Arcade section.
Another drawback was the food, which felt way too expensive for what was offered.

Despite these two points, we had a great time overall and would definitely visit again, mainly for the rides and overall carnival vibe.

The soft play area (₹300 for 30 minutes) was good and kids enjoyed it, but a major concern was that kids were released without being handed over to parents, which is a safety red flag.

featured_reviews.name: Rucha K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience at Basecamp Board Games. They have an excellent collection of board games, and what really stands out is how patiently the team teaches every game, making it easy even for first-timers to join in and enjoy. Everyone is warm, kind, and welcoming, and the whole space feels like a genuinely great community to be part of.

Also loved their Harry Potter event — it was incredibly immersive and thoughtfully done. You could really see the effort put into creating the experience. Definitely a place worth visiting if you enjoy board games and community-driven events.

featured_reviews.name: Shashwat Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text: It's genuinely one of the most welcoming communities. Everyone is friendly and Anirudh has done a great job of organizing events that allow beginners to play lots of new games. I've been a frequent participant and nothing but the best of things to say about this place.

featured_reviews.name: Saarth Padmakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great board game selection and helpful and friendly hosts! Weekend spots quickly fill up on the group and it's easy to see why once you've experienced the vibe, their philosophy is incredible where they promote trying out new games which you haven’t played or heard of before.

They teach any/every games and host a lot of beginner friendly meetups and heavy game sessions as well!

I was also informed they do custom tailor made games for particular occasions and have events all around the city but I really love the intimate cozy vibe here.

featured_reviews.name: priyal patil
featured_reviews.review_text: The hosts are really superb. It’s a great outlet for anyone even remotely interested in spending a fun few hours with boardgames and meeting genuine like minded people. They have an amazing collection of games. Happy that such a community is thriving here in Borivali. No worries if you are a beginner or pro, you would fit in seamlessly.

featured_reviews.name: prajeet khedekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Had such a great time at Base Camp with my friends! The place has a huge collection of board games, so we kept trying new ones and never got bored. The vibe is really chill and fun. We honestly lost track of time.

featured_reviews.name: Terence-Hari Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: A really fun spot to play board games of every persuasion. Anirudh, Saarth & Manish are passionate people who care about fostering a vibrant community. Will definitely seek out their events when I'm in Bombay!

name: The Boardgame Tavern
description:
Tired of searching for "Things to do in Mumbai" EVERY SINGLE WEEKEND only to be left disappointed? Would you rather spend your Saturdays:

✨ Socializing and making new friends 🤝🏽
✨ Fire up those brain cells and learn something new 🧠
✨ Escape to a new mystical, fantasy world of adventure and lore 🐉
Presenting to you, an INCREDIBLE introduction into the world of *boardgames and beyond* 🎲. A space to garner a new hobby or grow an already existing love towards the wonders of gaming culture ✨.
With a curated list of games ranging from fun, light hearted unwinders to the exciting world of strategy & intrigue, our *Game Master* is all set to take you on a journey that's *beyond just the rule book* 📖.
address: Holy Cross Rd, I C Colony, Borivali West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400103

featured_reviews.name: Mangesh Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was recently introduced to The Boardgame Tavern by a friend as a fun weekend activity, and I walked in with absolutely zero knowledge of board games or social deduction games like Blood on the Clocktower. My very first experience at BGT was playing BOTC, and honestly, it was incredible.

Even though I was playing alongside experienced players, the hosts, Suneet and Srushti, made the entire experience feel effortless and welcoming. They explained everything so well that I never felt out of place or overwhelmed. What could have been intimidating turned into a thoroughly enjoyable and engaging session. Since then, I genuinely look forward to attending BOTC games at the Tavern.

The hosts do a fantastic job of creating a fun, inclusive, and comfortable atmosphere for everyone, regardless of experience level. After my first BOTC session, I have gone on to attend several more BOTC games, other social games, and even a Level One D&D session, each of which has been equally enjoyable.

The Boardgame Tavern is truly a special place, and every visit leaves me excited for the next one. I am always looking forward to attending more BGT events and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great social gaming experience.

featured_reviews.name: Anushka Bose
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Board Game Tavern hosted by the wonderful Suneet and Srushti was hands down my best decision to spend a Saturday evening! Walked into a room full of strangers, but by the end it all felt like family. The vibe was so warm, welcoming and full of energy.

The game rounds were insanely fun I mean by the second round I honestly wanted to pull my hair out because we just couldn’t find the demon 😭 (in the best way possible). It was intense, hilarious and addictive all at once.

Such a unique experience with amazing hosts and an even better crowd. (Already can’t wait for the next game night!) Highly recommend this to anyone looking for something different and super fun to do in the city.

featured_reviews.name: Isha Ahuja
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve always had an amazing time here at the Board game Tavern! I’ve played Blood on the Clocktower, Dungeons and Dragons & a few social games with them and all were so nicely planned and executed. It shows they really love what they are doing. Srushti & Suneet are amazing hosts too! Though i’m a newbie to the board game community, Board games + coffee , cookies and catwatching sounds like a perfect weekend @ the BGT 🥰

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Kumar Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went to the Boardgame Tavern for a Dungeons & Dragons session just to understand the game… and walked out completely hooked. Suneet our Dungeon Master didn’t just run the game, he turned it into a real-life movie. Every scene felt immersive, every choice mattered, and the storytelling was top-tier.

You’ll come here for the games and get addicted to the cookies. 🤭

Special shoutout to Srushti, not just for the absolutely addictive cookies, but also for hand-painting the character minis for the game. That level of effort and creativity added so much soul to the experience.

Overall, an awesome place to come, make friends, and truly enjoy the games.

featured_reviews.name: Nandini Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: Boardgame Tavern is run by two wonderful hosts who are building a beautiful community of people who love board games, social games, role playing games and much more. The hosts graciously invite you to their home, where you go through a journey of playing strategy games, mind games, fun games with a group of people. While you start off saying you’ll spend only 4 hours there, time flies when you start playing these super fun and engaging games. BGT is not just another game cafe, it is a community building bonds, a homely vibe, a time of pure enjoyment and screen free joy. Highly recommended if you want to spend a fun filed weekend alone or with friends.

featured_reviews.name: Mounica Gotluru
featured_reviews.review_text: Very cool place for boardgames! Had attended D&D session. Really taken efforts for you to be included in the game and have fun. Plus the hosts are really fun and interactive. The sound effects during the game gave an altogether a different vibe and experience. Definitely give it a try!!

featured_reviews.name: Aryaman Patwardhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Boardgame Tavern has quickly become my favorite weekend spot. I’m here almost every Saturday and it always feels like home. Whether it’s diving into a Dungeons & Dragons one-shot (kudos to the effort both of the hosts take to make it a memorable adventure), or unraveling the identity of the imp in Blood on the Clocktower, or laughing through lighthearted social games like Psychiatrist, there’s always the perfect mix of fun and community.

Adding to the charm are the Tavern’s two adorable cats, who wander around making sure everyone knows whose turf it is. And every week, the host treats us with the most phenomenal homemade chocolate chip cookies, honestly worth the trip just for those!

If you’re looking for a cozy, welcoming place to play games, make friends, and share snacks, I can’t recommend the Board Game Tavern enough.

Oh and P.S. the occasional potluck’s!

featured_reviews.name: Akil Nayak R
featured_reviews.review_text:
The hosts are super passionate about board gaming. They consider board games an art and take immense care to maintain their games and curate their collection. I’ve had a great time playing through their collection and enjoyed the strategy discussions afterward.

Besides gaming, I loved their freshly baked cookies and befriending the resident cats.
